  • הערה מבצעית: המצב יציב אך עדין. סגירת שדות התעופה היא שינוי משמעותי ביכולת התמרון של איראן.

24.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iranian proxies (Hezbollah, Hamas) and Iran-fired missiles/rockets strike Israel. Northern border exchanges are daily.

Pause & diplomacy

  • Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iranian energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — claiming an "Iranian government request."
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — tactical risk that pauses will be broken.
  • US and Iranian negotiators reported heading to Doha — meeting uncertain.

Air, sea, and movement

  • Airspace disruptions: airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan reported closed intermittently.
  • Military flights observed (RCH5017, C‑130). Flight traffic levels fluctuating.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran allows passage for Russia, India, China; blocking other countries. Tactical: limited corridor for friendly supply lines; denies others access.

Northern border

  • Hezbollah firing at Israel daily. Lebanese army to be deployed along entire Israel border (TASS) — could reduce uncontrolled escalations if implemented.
  • Israel-Lebanon security annex text released; IDF redeployment discussed as eventual measure.

Gaza, West Bank, Syria

  • Israeli strike killed two and set tents ablaze in a Gaza humanitarian zone. Separate strikes killed four men and a boy in Gaza and a teenager in the West Bank.
  • IDF reported incursions/attacks inside southern Syria.

Regional proxies & capabilities

  • Houthis reportedly using ceasefire time to upgrade missile ranges — increases threat to Red Sea/Israel lines.
  • NATO/Italy allowed US planes to use bases for operations in the campaign.

Cyber & defense tech

  • Critical cyber incident reported. Monitor disruptions to civil/military networks.
  • Israeli radar AI firm won a contract for drone-attack warning systems — tactical boost to early warning.

Humanitarian & civilian impact

  • Civilian casualties in Gaza and West Bank. Displacement and damaged humanitarian infrastructure reported.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced and US‑Iran negotiators heading to Doha; new Israeli drone-warning tech contract awarded.
Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes despite pauses.

  • סגירות שדות תעופה: דיווחים על סגירות באיראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון וירדן.

סייבר וטכנולוגיה

  • נרשם אירוע סייבר קריטי. עקבו אחרי שיבושים ברשתות אזרחיות וצבאיות.

הומניטרי

  • אזרחים נפגעו בעזה ובהגדה; פגיעה בתשתיות הומניטריות ודחיפות סיוע.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הוכרזה הפסקת שבים שנייה; דיפלומטים בדרך לדוחה; חוזה טכנולוגי לשדרוג התרעה רחפנית.
הערכת איום: מתדרדר — סיכון גבוה לחזרה להתקפות רחבות.
